title.narrative: 1.1: A sophisticated and sustainable methodology for monitoring social media content and paid advertising on Facebook

description.narrative: 1.1: A sophisticated and sustainable methodology for monitoring social media content and paid advertising on Facebook

title.narrative: Number of social media pages monitored per month

description.narrative: Source and mean of verification: Records of the monitoring system

comment.narrative: 2020 Hashtag Generation has developed a sophisticated monitoring system capable of tracking patterns and trends in hate speech as well as mapping malign actors. It will be deployed in the context of this project and outputs will be shared with a wide range of civil society actors as well as Facebook and state bodies
2023 At least 750 pages are monitored per month leading to a total of 150 reports during the project lifecycle

The monitoring team compiled a list of social media pages to be monitored which consists of 1187 pages. The team uses a social listening tool that identifies the most widely circulated content from the bulk list of those pages.

title.narrative: 3.1: Complaints to local institutions and Facebook

description.narrative: 3.1: Complaints to local institutions and Facebook

title.narrative: Percentage of complaints which result in harmful content being removed

description.narrative: Source and mean of verification: Text of formal requests Text of formal responses

comment.narrative: 2020 Hashtag Generation has enjoyed considerable success in getting harmful content removed from Facebook and both Hashtag Generation and MDI will be able to use their trusted partner status to continue this momentum.
2023 At least 100 requests are made monthly and 85 of these complaints lead to content being removed.

For Facebook 42.8 of the reported incidents were removed from the platform while 19 were deemed Not Violating community Standards. A significant 38 of the total reported incidents failed to secure any response.For YouTube the number of responses to the complaints was poor as well. Of the responses that Hashtag Generation received only the reported videos were accounted for and not the comments. 58 Restrictions removal of the video were recorded which is a mere 21.

For Facebook 42.8 of the reported incidents were removed from the platform while 19 were deemed Not Violating community Standards. A significant 38 of the total reported incidents failed to secure any response.For YouTube the number of responses to the complaints was poor as well. Of the responses that Hashtag Generation received only the reported videos were accounted for and not the comments. 58 Restrictions removal of the video were recorded which is a mere 21.

title.narrative: To foster social cohesion in Sri Lanka by contributing to the creation of a healthy social media space where diverse views are freely shared

description.narrative: To foster social cohesion in Sri Lanka by contributing to the creation of a healthy social media space where diverse views are freely shared

title.narrative: Diverse groups take part in social mediabased discussions, as evidenced by CSOs

description.narrative: Source and mean of verification: CSO reports on social media space based on analytics

comment.narrative: 2020 Social media have been held responsible for incitement to violence and propagating extremist views
2023 online discussions feature a more balanced exchange of views

Project activities have addressed diverse communities and encouraged the engagement of both Tamil and Sinhala participants. Some project products reached out to over 200.000 people and generated over 7.000 engagements on Facebook Instagram and TikTok and project partners ensured the communication was accessible in both languages and participation of both communities was encouraged. In addition by raising awareness of hate speech and other information disorders targeting diverse groups and empowering members of both Tamil and Sinhala communities to recognise and take action against it GTTOSL contributed to more inclusive dialogue.

description.narrative: Source and mean of verification: Declared policy of social media operators, particularly Facebook

comment.narrative: 2020 Social media have been held responsible for incitement to violence and propagating extremist views
2023 An increase in the application of community standards is noted

Having in mind the number of content removal requests it is obvious that there is still a lack of adherence to the Community Standards. Only in the project year III there were 11526 removal requests on TikTok and 3418 on Meta. Low removal rates on platforms like Meta 47.8 indicate that even the efforts of civil society to flag the content are not always sufficient to have the content removed.However the GTTOSL achieved 94 of removals on TikTok the ongoing dialogue between project partners and big tech platforms and their commitments to provide feedback on the decisions not to remove the content are important achievements.
